methodology.movement: Like-for-like ticker and side are compared with the immediately prior Phase 4 snapshot.
methodology.persistence: A research-qualified side must repeat in at least 2 captures spaced 120-900 seconds apart.
methodology.forecast_boundary: The active forecast supplies diagnostic fair probabilities only. A provisional forecast blocks action eligibility regardless of apparent edge.
